sections.lead: LNH & Partner is a young Miami company built on two long track records. Style, our European group, has spent 25 years in premium interiors and window coverings. Luis Herrera brings 25+ years of civil engineering and large-scale development from Venezuela. That experience is what we brought to South Florida — the company here is new, the trade is not.
